question.text: The system shown in the adjacent figure is in equilibrium. The mass of the container with liquid is M, the density of the liquid in the container is ρ and volume of the block is V. If the container is now displaced downwards through a distance x0 and released such that block remains well inside the liquid, during subsequent motion (ignore viscosity)
